main.en: Hi, I have a reservation under the name Lin.
main.zh: 你好，我有訂房，名字是 Lin。

replies.en: Welcome. May I see your passport, please?
replies.zh: 歡迎光臨，可以給我看您的護照嗎？

main.en: I'd like to check in, please.
main.zh: 我想辦理入住。

replies.en: Of course. How many nights will you be staying?
replies.zh: 好的，請問您要住幾晚？

main.en: Can I check in early? My room isn't ready yet?
main.zh: 我可以提早入住嗎？還是房間還沒好？

replies.en: Check-in is at 3 p.m., but you can leave your bags with us.
replies.zh: 入住時間是下午三點，但您可以先把行李寄放在我們這。

main.en: Could I have a room on a higher floor?
main.zh: 可以給我高樓層的房間嗎？

replies.en: Sure, I can put you on the 12th floor.
replies.zh: 沒問題，我幫您安排在 12 樓。

main.en: I'd prefer a quiet room, away from the elevator.
main.zh: 我想要安靜一點、離電梯遠一點的房間。

replies.en: No problem, I'll arrange that for you.
replies.zh: 沒問題，我幫您安排。

main.en: Is breakfast included?
main.zh: 有附早餐嗎？

replies.en: Yes, it's served from 7 to 10 on the second floor.
replies.zh: 有的，早餐在二樓，供應時間是 7 點到 10 點。

replies.en: Breakfast is extra, twenty dollars per person.
replies.zh: 早餐要另外付費，每人 20 元。

main.en: What's the Wi-Fi password?
main.zh: Wi-Fi 密碼是什麼？

replies.en: It's printed on the back of your key card.
replies.zh: 印在您房卡的背面。

main.en: What time is checkout?
main.zh: 退房時間是幾點？

replies.en: Checkout is at 11 a.m.
replies.zh: 退房時間是上午 11 點。

main.en: Could I get a late checkout, around 2 p.m.?
main.zh: 我可以延後退房嗎，大概下午兩點？

replies.en: Sure, that's fine.
replies.zh: 沒問題，可以的。

replies.en: There may be a small extra charge for that.
replies.zh: 這可能會酌收一點費用。

main.en: Do you have parking?
main.zh: 請問有停車場嗎？

replies.en: Yes, there's a garage in the basement.
replies.zh: 有的，地下室有停車場。

main.en: Could you keep my luggage until the afternoon?
main.zh: 可以幫我把行李寄放到下午嗎？

replies.en: Of course. Here's your tag.
replies.zh: 當然可以，這是您的行李牌。

main.en: Could I have a wake-up call at 6 a.m.?
main.zh: 可以幫我設早上六點的叫醒服務嗎？

replies.en: Certainly, six a.m. It's all set.
replies.zh: 好的，早上六點，已經設定好了。

main.en: Could you call a taxi for me?
main.zh: 可以幫我叫一台計程車嗎？

replies.en: Sure, it'll be here in about five minutes.
replies.zh: 沒問題，大約五分鐘後到。

main.en: Could I have some extra towels, please?
main.zh: 可以多給我幾條毛巾嗎？

replies.en: Of course, I'll send them up right away.
replies.zh: 當然，我馬上請人送上去。

main.en: The air conditioning isn't working.
main.zh: 冷氣壞了，沒有在運作。

replies.en: I'm sorry. I'll send someone to check it now.
replies.zh: 很抱歉，我馬上派人去檢查。

main.en: There's no hot water in my room.
main.zh: 我房間沒有熱水。

replies.en: I apologize. We'll fix it as soon as possible.
replies.zh: 很抱歉，我們會盡快處理。

main.en: My key card isn't working.
main.zh: 我的房卡刷不開門。

replies.en: Let me reactivate it for you.
replies.zh: 我幫您重新設定。

main.en: The room next door is very noisy. Could you help?
main.zh: 隔壁房間很吵，可以幫忙處理嗎？

replies.en: I'm sorry, I'll take care of it right away.
replies.zh: 很抱歉，我馬上處理。

main.en: Could you clean my room, please?
main.zh: 可以幫我打掃房間嗎？

replies.en: Sure, housekeeping will come by shortly.
replies.zh: 好的，房務人員稍後就過去。

main.en: Do you have a laundry service?
main.zh: 有洗衣服務嗎？

replies.en: Yes, just leave it in the bag in your closet.
replies.zh: 有的，放進衣櫃裡的洗衣袋就可以了。

main.en: Can I get an extra night? I'd like to stay one more day.
main.zh: 我可以多住一晚嗎？想再多待一天。

replies.en: Let me check availability for you.
replies.zh: 我幫您查一下還有沒有空房。

main.en: How do I get to the city center from here?
main.zh: 從這裡要怎麼去市中心？

replies.en: The subway is a five-minute walk, exit and turn left.
replies.zh: 地鐵站走路五分鐘，出門左轉就到。

main.en: I'd like to check out, please.
main.zh: 我要退房。

replies.en: Sure. How was your stay?
replies.zh: 好的，這次住得還滿意嗎？

main.en: There seems to be a mistake on my bill.
main.zh: 我的帳單好像有錯。

replies.en: Let me check that for you right away.
replies.zh: 我馬上幫您確認。
